script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: career transition

Begin screenplay.

INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

A modern coffee shop, filled with chattering patrons, glowing screens, and the clanging of lattes being made.

Our PROTAGONIST, JAMES (40s, a disheveled man with a laptop bag slung over his shoulder), sits at a small table, staring at an email on his laptop. The email is a notice of termination from his job at a large technology corporation.

James looks up as the barista calls his name, holding out a steaming cup of coffee. He takes a sip, then leans back in his chair, deep in thought.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits in the dimly lit living room, surrounded by stacks of old textbooks and scientific journals. He's been spending every waking hour researching alternative energy solutions, a longtime passion of his.

He hears a knock at the door. It's his neighbor, MIA (30s, a confident and ambitious woman who works in renewable energy).

Mia: (smiling) I heard about the job thing. I'm really sorry, James.

James: (sighs) It's not the end of the world. I'll find something.

Mia: (eyes twinkling) I have an idea. I think you'd be perfect for a position at my company. They're always looking for bright minds in the field of alternative energy.

James is taken aback but intrigued.

James: (hesitant) I'd have to start from the bottom, though, right?

Mia: (nods) Absolutely. But you have the knowledge and the passion. It won't be long before you're making a real difference.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - DAY

James spends the next few days packing up his belongings and preparing for the move to Mia's company. He's excited but nervous about starting over.

As he finishes packing, he receives a call from his former boss, offering him his old job back. James hesitates, then declines the offer, citing his newfound passion and opportunity.

EXT. RENEWABLE ENERGY COMPANY - DAY

James arrives at Mia's company, a sleek, eco-friendly building with solar panels on the roof. He's greeted warmly by Mia and the other employees, who take him on a tour of the facility.

INT. RESEARCH & DEVELOPMENT LAB - DAY

James is introduced to his new team and begins work on a cutting-edge alternative energy project. He's challenged, but invigorated by the opportunity to make a difference in the world.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits in his new, smaller apartment, feeling a sense of accomplishment and purpose. He looks up from his laptop as a notification pops up on the screen - a message from his former boss, congratulating him on his new position.

James smiles, taking a deep breath. This is just the beginning.

FADE OUT.
